recommendation: AssemblyAI Sync live STT (Universal-3.5 Pro) + our own LLM cleanup pass (Gemma 4 31B on AssemblyAI LLM Gateway), hedged after 2.5 s so the slow primary tail is bounded

audio_capture.notes: Capture 16 kHz mono; keep a WAV/PCM buffer locally as the batch-fallback payload.

multipart_order: config (application/json) - MUST be sent before audio
audio (audio/pcm) - raw S16LE, streamed as captured

config.prompt: A work dictation from a software founder, PM or engineer: messages, emails, meeting notes, technical instructions and casual replies. Vocabulary includes AI and developer tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemma, gpt-oss, Grok, Groq, Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, Tauri, Supabase, Linear, Notion, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Next.js, shadcn), the company Helion, teammates' names, and the product Ray. Speech may contain filler words, false starts and self-corrections; transcribe faithfully.

primary.response: JSON: {text, words[{text,confidence}], confidence, audio_duration_ms, session_id, request_time_ms}
primary.notes: Server transcribes during upload; only the tail + final decode remain after the user stops. No partial transcripts are returned. 120 s cap per request: for longer dictations, close and reopen the request at a silence boundary (or fall back to batch) and concatenate.

fallback.body: multipart: config (JSON, includes prompt + keyterms_prompt) + audio (audio/wav or audio/pcm)
fallback.when: live connection fails, 429/503, or upload exceeds 120 s without a clean break

rejected.reason: Faster to integrate but loses content (deletes instruction-like sentences; dropped words), fails contextual name disambiguation (Grok/Groq), and rewrite latency is higher (p50 1.85-1.94 s, p95 3.6 s). Price $0.62/hr incl. rewrite.

stt.pricing_note: Sync STT $0.45/hr + $0.05/hr keyterms on the current pricing page; some AssemblyAI pages list $0.30/hr. Budget at $0.45.

placeholders.{{DICTIONARY}}: JSON array of user dictionary terms
placeholders.{{KNOWN_NAMES}}: JSON array of built-in product/company names
placeholders.{{APP_NAME}}: JSON string of the foreground app/process name or 'unknown'

request.max_tokens_note: 3000 leaves room for the answer plus a reasoning model's internal tokens; 1500 was consumed entirely by reasoning on the 2-minute monologue.
request.hedging: The app may start a second provider in parallel if the primary has not produced a valid answer after hedge_after_ms (or has already failed). First valid answer wins; the loser is cancelled. Chosen from the measured primary p95 (~2.6-2.8 s cold); warm calls are usually under 0.8 s. This research artifact measures the primary only.

structured_mode.fallback: none; the raw transcript is the last resort
structured_mode.guard: rejects added causal/inferential connectives (because, since, therefore, thus, hence, so that, which means, as a result, consequently) with token-sequence matching

primary.rate_limit: 30 requests/min per model (paid accounts; free accounts cannot use LLM Gateway)
primary.quality: best: contextual Grok/Groq, paragraphing, lists, instruction preservation

last_resort.note: Always better than dropping the dictation; raw text is punctuated and readable.

model_sweep_2026-11-01.aai_gateway_listed_but_not_accessible: gemini, claude, gpt-5, deepseek, kimi, grok, glm, nemotron, minimax and muse return 'Your account does not have access to this LLM Gateway model'
model_sweep_2026-11-01.outcome: gemma-4-31b stays primary for quality. The gateway exposes only gemma-4-31b and qwen3.5-4b-32k-fast to this account. qwen3.5-4b-32k-fast scored lower and produced 98 s timeout tails. The historical second-provider models are no longer part of the pipeline.

retry_policy.then: retry the primary, then use the raw transcript
retry_policy.context: The primary is hedged rather than retried on the tail: a second provider may start at hedge_after_ms and the first valid answer wins.

steps: 1. Hotkey down: open STT live request, send config part immediately, then PCM chunks every ~200 ms.
2. Hotkey up: send final multipart boundary; await JSON transcript (post-stop ~0.5-0.7 s typical).
3. Build system prompt with dictionary + known names + foreground app name; send transcript in <transcript> tags.
4. Stream LLM response; on first token show progress in the HUD; insert complete text at caret on completion.
5. If STT returns empty/short noise, do nothing; if LLM fails, insert raw transcript.

cost_estimate_per_1000_dictations_15s.note: STT at $0.45-0.50/hr including keyterms; ~4.2 h audio

round2_measurements.note: Round-1 baseline is the cold app_final run; round-2 warm runs pre-warm the gateway during recording, as the app does.
